install_tell: No vendor SaaS endpoint in LiteLLM hook; akto_base_url is REQUIRED, operator-supplied. Akto is primarily an API-security vendor whose guardrail product is operator-hosted (often on the same cluster as the upstream LiteLLM proxy). HTTP_PROXY_PATH is the constant '/api/http-proxy' and the hook mirrors the LLM request as a flat payload.
misconfig_patterns: Operator-hosted: typical pattern is in-cluster service exposed via Ingress; if Ingress allows external access without service-mesh auth, the proxy mirroring endpoint is reachable
AKTO_GUARDRAIL_API_BASE env var leak in operator config repos
